description: This notice is a detailed market investigation, ie a request for information. A project will be launched at VTT to measure wind flows in wind power plants. Three devices must be delivered installed on top of two Enercon E70 2.3 MW turbines and two devices on top of one Vestas V126 3.3 MW turbine.
